title: Matcha Mousse
description: A light and airy Japanese dessert infused with the richness of matcha green tea. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Line a 9-inch (23cm) springform pan with parchment paper.
In a blender, combine the tofu, matcha powder, sugar, and cocoa powder. Blend until smooth.
Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.
Once cooled, refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
To serve, top with chocolate shavings and drizzle with chocolate syrup.
